ov: The common carp is a large freshwater fish of lakes and rivers in Europe and Asia. It has been domesticated and spread worldwide, where it’s often invasive, though wild populations are Vulnerable.

why.dm: Carp have been domesticated for food and ornament and introduced worldwide.
why.p: Koi, the colourful ornamental carp kept in ponds, were bred in Japan from the 1820s.
why.et: Farmed since Roman times, and spread across Europe as a food fish by monks.

rg: Native to Europe and Asia; introduced worldwide.
fx: It is on the list of the world’s 100 worst invasive species.
